EXPENSE POLICY

2. Receipts: any expense above EUR 30 needs a receipt; mileage needs none.
3. Hotels: up to EUR 280 per night in Geneva, London, Copenhagen; up to EUR 120 per night elsewhere.

A claim is reimbursable in full only if it follows every rule.

A line is reimbursable in full only if it meets every rule.
